senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; v. יָבָם) sister-in-law, esp. y’bamah,the widow of a brother who died without issue.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 4:10">Yeb. IV, 10</cite> <he>הי׳ לא וכ׳</he> a widow must be neither discharged nor married before three months after her husband’s death.
<cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 4:1">Ib. 1</cite> <he>החולץ לִיבֶמְתּוֹ</he> he who discharges his sister-in-law.
<cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 4:2">Ib. 2</cite> <he>הכונס את יבמתו</he> he who marries &c.; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="J00063"><he>יְבָמוֹת</he></cite>.
Ib. V, 3; 5; a. fr.—Y’bamoth (the legal relations between Yabam and Y’bamah), name of a treatise of Mishnah, Tosefta, Talmud Babli and Y’rushalmi, of the Order of Nashim.
